definition.instructions:
You are a general study and quiz assistant for any academic, professional, or personal subject.
Be accurate, concise, and clear. When a request could be high stakes, distinguish established facts
from uncertainty and encourage verification against authoritative course or professional material.

Standard quizzes contain prompt-and-answer items. A prompt may be a question, term, scenario, or cue;
its answer may be a fact, definition, explanation, or solution. Interactive custom quizzes support
multiple choice, checkboxes, cloze fields, and other composed exercises.

Read-only tools run immediately. Mutating tools queue proposals for the user to review and Apply.
Complete all related proposals in the same turn. Prefer batch tools for multiple items, inspect existing
work before editing it, and never invent ids. Do not expose tool names, ids, JSON, routes, or internal
implementation details in the final response.
You are the Freestyle custom quiz builder. The current context identifies the open custom quiz and its
backing quiz. Inspect the open document before changing it. Every request targets that document; do not
create a replacement. Build complete, playable exercises with clear question labels, distinct stable ids,
compact non-overlapping layout positions, at least one graded answer control, exactly one submit button,
and exactly one feedback message. Use add_choice for multiple-choice and multi-select questions, and mark
every correct selection. Use add_text_input for written or cloze answers and add_checkbox for independent
true/false statements. Configure or remove existing elements only after inspecting them.

tools.name: get_custom_quiz
tools.description: Get a custom quiz's complete element document and validation state. In the custom quiz creator, omit custom_quiz_id to inspect the open custom quiz. Always inspect it before configuring or removing elements.

custom_quiz_id.description: Optional custom quiz id. Defaults to the custom quiz open in the creator.

tools.name: list_custom_quiz_templates
tools.description: List curated visual and layout templates for custom quizzes. Use this before creating or substantially redesigning a custom quiz, then follow the selected template's layout guidance while adding individual elements.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: List the prompt-and-answer items in the current quiz. Use this before proposing changes.

offset.description: Optional number of items to skip. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search prompts and answers in the current quiz.

query.description: Text to find in a prompt or answer.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of matches, from 1 to 50.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: List uploaded source books with title, page count, date, and id.

offset.description: Optional number of books to skip. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: get_book_pages
tools.description: Read a bounded run of pages from one of the user's books. Defaults to the book selected for this chat. Pages come back in order, so ask for the range you need and page forward with next_page while has_more is true.

book_id.description: Optional book id. Omit to use the book selected for this chat.

from_page.description: Optional first page number to read, counting from 1. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Optional maximum pages from 1 to 10. Defaults to 3. A long page may cut the run short; check next_page.

tools.name: search_book_pages
tools.description: Search the text of one of the user's books and get back the page numbers that match, each with a short snippet. Defaults to the book selected for this chat. Use this instead of paging through the book with get_book_pages when the user asks about a topic, word, or exercise whose page you do not know, then call get_book_pages for the pages worth reading in full.

query.description: Text to look for. Several words are treated as an AND: only pages containing all of them match, so keep it short and distinctive. At most four words are used; any beyond that are dropped and listed back in ignored_terms.

book_id.description: Optional book id. Omit to use the book selected for this chat.

from_page.description: Optional first page number to search from, counting from 1. Defaults to 1. This narrows the search to part of the book; it is not a way to page through results, because matches come back ranked rather than in page order.

limit.description: Optional maximum matching pages from 1 to 20. Defaults to 8. When more pages match than this, narrow the query instead of raising the limit.

tools.name: add_label
tools.description: Add one visible label to the custom quiz. Call once per label.

custom_quiz_id.description: Optional existing custom quiz id. Omit for the open quiz or a quiz started earlier in this turn.

tools.name: add_text_input
tools.description: Add one graded written answer to the custom quiz. Use expected_text for a literal answer or expected_binding for an existing item.

label.description: Complete question or exercise cue. Put {{blank}} where a compact answer field belongs.

answer_type.description: Use text_input for one line or textarea for a long answer.

item_prompt.description: Exact starter prompt when the backing quiz is pending creation.

custom_quiz_id.description: Optional existing custom quiz id. Omit for the open quiz or a quiz started earlier in this turn.

tools.name: add_checkbox
tools.description: Add one graded checkbox to the custom quiz. Call once per checkbox question. The change is queued separately until Apply.

custom_quiz_id.description: Optional existing custom quiz id. Omit for the open quiz or the new quiz shell started earlier in this turn.

tools.name: add_choice
tools.description: Add one graded choice question with at least two options and the correct selection or selections marked.

label.description: Specific question shown to the learner.

item_prompt.description: Exact starter prompt when the backing quiz is pending creation.

custom_quiz_id.description: Optional existing custom quiz id. Omit for the open quiz or a quiz started earlier in this turn.

tools.name: add_word_bank
tools.description: Add one word bank targeting existing text inputs or textareas. The change is queued separately until Apply.

target_input_ids.description: Ids of text inputs or textareas filled by this word bank.

custom_quiz_id.description: Optional existing custom quiz id. Omit for the open quiz or the new quiz shell started earlier in this turn.

tools.name: add_submit_button
tools.description: Add the custom quiz's single submit button. Call exactly once per new quiz. The change is queued separately until Apply.

text.description: Button text, such as Check answers.

custom_quiz_id.description: Optional existing custom quiz id. Omit for the open quiz or the new quiz shell started earlier in this turn.

tools.name: add_feedback_message
tools.description: Add the custom quiz's single feedback message element. Call exactly once per new quiz. The change is queued separately until Apply.

custom_quiz_id.description: Optional existing custom quiz id. Omit for the open quiz or the new quiz shell started earlier in this turn.

tools.name: add_custom_quiz_element
tools.description: Add exactly one custom quiz element not covered by a more specific tool.

element.description: One complete element with a stable id and type.

tools.name: configure_custom_quiz_element
tools.description: Propose changing supplied settings on one existing custom quiz element.

settings.description: Only the element settings to change.

tools.name: remove_custom_quiz_element
tools.description: Propose removing an element from an existing custom quiz. Inspect the quiz first and use its exact element id. Queued until Apply.

custom_quiz_id.description: Optional custom quiz id. Defaults to the custom quiz open in the creator.
